Enterprise SSO cost: what your first enterprise customers will really cost

Answer: For 2–3 enterprise customers (3 SSO connections), as of 2026-10-31: at 5k users the cheapest verified plans are Stytch Pay as you go (B2B) and Descope Free Forever (tie at $0), then Amazon Cognito Lite $8.25/mo (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection $89.25/mo, #4 of 17), Firebase Auth / Identity Platform Pay as you go $8.25/mo (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection $89.25/mo, #4 of 17), Supabase Auth Pro (platform) $33.25/mo (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection $114.25/mo, #7 of 17) (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection). At 10k users: Stytch Pay as you go (B2B) (tie at $0), then Amazon Cognito Lite $8.25/mo (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection $89.25/mo, #3 of 16), Firebase Auth / Identity Platform Pay as you go $8.25/mo (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection $89.25/mo, #3 of 16), Supabase Auth Pro (platform) $33.25/mo (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection $114.25/mo, #6 of 16) (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection). The cheapest paid plan whose SSO price does not depend on SSO-user counts at 10k users is Kinde Plus at $75/mo.

“Auth0 wants $800/month”: the Auth0 SSO math

Auth0 B2B Professional lists $800/mo at its 1,000-MAU tier with 5 enterprise connections included; B2B Essentials lists $300/mo at 1,000 MAU ($1,300/mo at 5,000) with 3 included. Extra connections are $100/mo each, up to 30. Auth0 Free includes 1 enterprise connection up to 25,000 MAU. Compare Auth0 pricing tiers and Clerk vs Auth0.

The 3 ways vendors charge for enterprise SSO

Per connection

Clerk, Auth0, WorkOS, Stytch, Logto and Descope. Each enterprise customer’s IdP (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace) is one connection with a monthly fee, usually after a few included. Cheap for 1–3 customers, expensive at 25.

Unlimited in the base fee

Kinde. Paid tiers include unlimited SSO, so the bill tracks users, not customers. Best when you expect many small enterprise customers.

Per SSO user

Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform. Each SAML/OIDC user is billed per month (first 50 free, then $0.015). Cheapest for small customers; grows with every seat they bring.

B2B org fees: does my organization count change the bill?

Yes for Clerk, Auth0, Descope, Kinde and Logto. At 10k users with 1 SSO customer (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection, 200 members), Clerk Pro is $125/mo because more than 20 members per org needs the B2B Authentication add-on ($100/mo); with 20 or fewer members it is $25/mo. Auth0 Free lists $0 but caps at 5 organizations. At 10k users and 150 organizations (no SSO): Clerk Pro $175/mo (incl. $150 org fees), Descope Pro $364/mo (incl. $115), Kinde Pro $75/mo (incl. $50); Auth0 Free and B2C plans are out (5 and 10-org caps).

“Migrating SSO/SCIM sounds like it might be a bit of a pain”

It is per customer: each connection means re-configuring that customer’s IdP. If you expect more than a handful of enterprise customers, compare the 10- and 25-connection columns before you pick, not just the free tier. Self-hosting? Self-hosting an open-source library such as Better Auth (SSO plugin: SAML 2.0 and OIDC) has no per-connection license fee; you carry setup and support. Better Auth’s optional managed infrastructure lists self-service SSO at 1 connection, then $50/month per connection (on the $20/mo Infrastructure Pro plan, better-auth.com/pricing, read 2026-10-31). See self-hosted auth cost.

Not in the ledger yet: SSO-only vendors such as Scalekit and SSOJet. We add a vendor only after reading its pricing page; until then we don’t quote it.

Questions

What is the cheapest auth for 2–3 enterprise SSO customers?

For 2–3 enterprise customers (3 SSO connections), as of 2026-10-31: at 5k users the cheapest verified plans are Stytch Pay as you go (B2B) and Descope Free Forever (tie at $0), then Amazon Cognito Lite $8.25/mo (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection $89.25/mo, #4 of 17), Firebase Auth / Identity Platform Pay as you go $8.25/mo (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection $89.25/mo, #4 of 17), Supabase Auth Pro (platform) $33.25/mo (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection $114.25/mo, #7 of 17) (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection). At 10k users: Stytch Pay as you go (B2B) (tie at $0), then Amazon Cognito Lite $8.25/mo (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection $89.25/mo, #3 of 16), Firebase Auth / Identity Platform Pay as you go $8.25/mo (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection $89.25/mo, #3 of 16), Supabase Auth Pro (platform) $33.25/mo (assumes 200 SSO users per connection; at 2,000 per connection $114.25/mo, #6 of 16) (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection). The cheapest paid plan whose SSO price does not depend on SSO-user counts at 10k users is Kinde Plus at $75/mo.

“Auth0 wants $800/month for SSO”: is that right?

Auth0 B2B Professional lists $800/mo at its 1,000-MAU tier with 5 enterprise connections included; B2B Essentials lists $300/mo at 1,000 MAU ($1,300/mo at 5,000) with 3 included. Extra connections are $100/mo each, up to 30. Auth0 Free includes 1 enterprise connection up to 25,000 MAU.

What are the 3 ways auth vendors charge for enterprise SSO?

1) Per connection: Clerk, Auth0, WorkOS, Stytch, Logto and Descope charge a monthly fee per enterprise SSO connection, often after a few included (e.g. WorkOS $125 each from the first, Clerk Pro 1 included then $75). 2) Unlimited in the base fee: Kinde include unlimited SSO on paid tiers, so cost tracks users, not customers. 3) Per SSO user: Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform bill each SAML/OIDC user a month (first 50 free, then $0.015), so a big enterprise customer costs more than a small one.

Why do Firebase, Supabase and Cognito SSO prices depend on user counts?

Because Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform bill SAML/OIDC per SSO user, their SSO cost depends on how many people each enterprise customer signs in. We assume 200 SSO users per connection unless you change it. At 10k users with 3 connections: Amazon Cognito $8.25/mo (at 1,000 per connection $44.25/mo, #2 of 16; at 2,000 per connection $89.25/mo, #3 of 16); Supabase Auth $33.25/mo (at 1,000 per connection $69.25/mo, #5 of 16; at 2,000 per connection $114.25/mo, #6 of 16); Firebase Auth / Identity Platform $8.25/mo (at 1,000 per connection $44.25/mo, #2 of 16; at 2,000 per connection $89.25/mo, #3 of 16).

Does self-hosting avoid the SSO tax?

Self-hosting an open-source library such as Better Auth (SSO plugin: SAML 2.0 and OIDC) has no per-connection license fee; you carry setup and support. Better Auth’s optional managed infrastructure lists self-service SSO at 1 connection, then $50/month per connection (on the $20/mo Infrastructure Pro plan, better-auth.com/pricing, read 2026-10-31).

I’m B2B with organizations: does that change the SSO bill?

Yes for Clerk, Auth0, Descope, Kinde and Logto. At 10k users with 1 SSO customer (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection, 200 members), Clerk Pro is $125/mo because more than 20 members per org needs the B2B Authentication add-on ($100/mo); with 20 or fewer members it is $25/mo. Auth0 Free lists $0 but caps at 5 organizations. At 10k users and 150 organizations (no SSO): Clerk Pro $175/mo (incl. $150 org fees), Descope Pro $364/mo (incl. $115), Kinde Pro $75/mo (incl. $50); Auth0 Free and B2C plans are out (5 and 10-org caps).
